<infobox theme="Planet">
	<image source="imagefallback">
		<default>{{InfoboxGallery|image={{{image|}}}|caption1={{{option1|}}}|image2={{{image2|}}}|caption2={{{option2|}}}}}</default>
	</image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Astrographical information</header>
        <data source="region"><label>Region</label></data>	
        <data source="sector"><label>Sector</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|n/a||{{{sector|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="system"><label>System</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{system}}}}}|none||{{{system|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="coordinates"><label>Grid square</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates}}}}}|n/a||{{{coordinates|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="xyz"><label>XYZ coordinates</label></data>
        <data source="distance"><label>Distance from Core</label></data>
        <data source="suns"><label>Suns</label></data>
        <data source="orbited"><label>Orbited body</label></data>
        <data source="position"><label>Orbital position</label></data>
        <data source="moons"><label>Moons</label></data>	
        <data source="routes"><label>Trade routes</label></data>		
        <data source="lengthday"><label>Rotation period</label></data>
        <data source="lengthyear"><label>Orbital period</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Physical information</header>
        <data source="class"><label>Class</label></data>	
        <data source="diameter"><label>Diameter</label></data>	
        <data source="atmosphere"><label>Atmosphere</label></data>	
        <data source="climate"><label>Climate</label></data>	
        <data source="gravity"><label>Gravity</label></data>        
        <data source="terrain"><label>Terrain</label></data>
        <data source="water"><label>Surface water</label></data>
        <data source="interest"><label>Points of interest</label></data>	
        <data source="flora"><label>Flora</label></data>
        <data source="fauna"><label>Fauna</label></data>
        <data source="otherlife"><label>Other lifeforms</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Societal information</header>
        <data source="species"><label>Native species</label></data>	
        <data source="otherspecies"><label>Other species</label></data>
        <data source="socialgroup"><label>Socio-cultural group(s)</label></data>
        <data source="language"><label>Primary language(s)</label></data>
        <data source="government"><label>Government</label></data>
        <data source="population"><label>Population</label></data>
        <data source="demonym"><label>Demonym</label></data>
        <data source="cities"><label>Major cities</label></data>
        <data source="imports"><label>Major imports</label></data>
        <data source="exports"><label>Major exports</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>	
	</group>
    <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:CelestialBody|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|region|sector|system|coordinates|xyz|distance|suns|orbited|position|moons|routes|lengthday|lengthyear|class|diameter|atmosphere|climate|gravity|terrain|water|interest|flora|fauna|otherlife|species|otherspecies|socialgroup|language|government|population|demonym|cities|imports|exports|affiliation|optional=image2,option1,option2,no_grid_check,unlisted|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{NAMESPACE}}{{{no_grid_check|}}}||{{#invoke:PlanetGridCheck|main|outside=1|unlisted={{{unlisted|}}}|region={{{region|}}}|sector={{{sector|}}}|system={{{system|}}}|orbited={{{orbited|}}}}}}}<noinclude>

==Usage instructions==
{{AstroCategoryDoc}}

Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.

|sector=

|coordinates=
|xyz=
|distance=
|suns=
|orbited=

|lengthday=
|lengthyear=
|class=
|diameter=
|atmosphere=
|climate=
|gravity=
|terrain=

|flora=
